texts.label: Founder message: heading
texts.text: Message from the Founder Chairman & CEO

texts.label: Founder message: first paragraph
texts.text: Sahara Jan Kalyan Samiti has grown from community-led work into programmes supporting education, healthcare, nutrition, women's livelihoods, renewable energy and environmental awareness across 12 districts of Madhya Pradesh.

texts.label: Founder message: quote 1
texts.text: "Our journey began with a singular belief: true social welfare is not about charity, but about empowering communities to stand strong on their own feet."

texts.label: Founder message: quote 2
texts.text: "Over the years, our dedicated teams of local volunteers, doctors, teachers, and eco-activists have worked tirelessly at the grassroots level. Every step is guided by empathy and accountability."

texts.label: Founder message: quote 3
texts.text: "I invite donors, corporate CSR partners, and passionate volunteers to join hands with us as we build healthy, educated, and self-supporting communities."

texts.label: Founder: line on the photo card
texts.text: 25+ years in social development and community empowerment

texts.label: Mission & Vision: heading
texts.text: Our Purpose and Foundational Guiding Values

texts.label: Vision: text
texts.text: To build a world-class social development organization creating an equitable, inclusive, healthy, and empowered society, free from discrimination, poverty, and inequality.

texts.label: Mission: text
texts.text: Empower communities through sustainable development interventions in education, health, livelihood, women empowerment, environment, renewable energy, youth development, and social justice while strengthening community participation and institutional capacity.

texts.label: Core value 1: text
texts.text: Excellence through research, innovation, continuous improvement, transparency, accountability and professional management systems.

texts.label: Core value 2: text
texts.text: Serving communities with empathy, compassion, dignity and respect for every individual.

texts.label: Core value 3: text
texts.text: Sustainable development is possible only through active community participation and ownership.

texts.label: Core value 4: text
texts.text: Transparency, accountability and ethical governance in all organisational processes and programmes.

texts.label: Philosophy: quote
texts.text: The planting of trees is the least self-centered of all that we do. Someone enjoys the shade and fruits today because someone planted a tree a long time ago.

texts.label: Philosophy: text
texts.text: Deeply rooted values, volunteers as nurturing agents, and a long-term commitment to growth that benefits future generations.

texts.label: Thematic area 1: text
texts.text: School education support, digital learning, girls' education, remedial education, scholarship support and career guidance.

texts.label: Thematic area 2: text
texts.text: Health awareness camps, maternal & child health, nutrition programmes and community health interventions.

texts.label: Thematic area 3: text
texts.text: School sanitation programmes, hygiene awareness and safe drinking water promotion.

texts.label: Thematic area 4: text
texts.text: Self Help Groups, livelihood promotion, skill training and leadership development.

texts.label: Thematic area 5: text
texts.text: Community mobilisation, traditional knowledge promotion, and education & health support.

texts.label: Thematic area 6: text
texts.text: Tree plantation, solar awareness campaigns, renewable energy promotion and climate awareness.

texts.label: Thematic area 7: text
texts.text: Vocational training, entrepreneurship development, sports promotion, leadership & life skills.

texts.label: Thematic area 8: text
texts.text: Maternal health, neonatal care systems, nutritional support and community training in remote districts.

texts.label: Where we work: text
texts.text: With 20+ years of grassroots field experience, the Samiti works with marginalised, tribal, rural and underprivileged communities through participatory, community-driven development.

texts.label: Banner text
texts.text: Comprehensive interventions designed for long-term community resilience.

texts.label: Women Empowerment: description
texts.text: Job skills training, Self-Help Groups (SHGs) support, and financial literacy workshops helping rural and urban women achieve financial independence.

texts.label: Medical Facilities: description
texts.text: Funding for hospitals and medical facilities, treatment assistance for patients who cannot afford care, and free health check-up camps in remote villages.

texts.label: Child Education: description
texts.text: Free community learning centers, remedial classes, school kits, uniforms, and digital literacy outreach for underprivileged children.

texts.label: Environment: description
texts.text: Massive native tree plantation campaigns, eco-workshops, plastic-free market drives, and community clean-up initiatives.

texts.label: Social Relief: description
texts.text: Emergency disaster relief, seasonal blanket & clothing drives, ration kits for senior citizens, and community food drives.

texts.label: Renewable Energy: description
texts.text: Solar LED lanterns with charging panels for off-grid tribal families in forest-fringe villages of Sagar district, in partnership with Jiv Daya Foundation, USA.

texts.label: Section 1 (Information we collect): paragraph 1
texts.text: Details you give us through our forms: name, email address, phone number, organisation, postal address (only for hard-copy requests) and the message you write.

texts.label: Section 1 (Information we collect): paragraph 2
texts.text: Donation details needed to issue receipts, such as name, email, phone and PAN (for 80G receipts). Card, UPI and bank details are handled by the payment gateway and are not stored by us.

texts.label: Section 2 (How we use it): paragraph 1
texts.text: To reply to your enquiry, process document requests, register volunteers and event attendees, issue donation receipts, and send newsletters you subscribed to.

texts.label: Section 2 (How we use it): paragraph 2
texts.text: We do not sell or rent your personal information.

texts.label: Section 3 (Sharing): paragraph 1
texts.text: We share data only with service providers who help us run the website, send email or process payments, and with authorities when the law requires it.

texts.label: Section 4 (Retention and security): paragraph 1
texts.text: We keep your information only as long as needed for the purpose it was given, or as required by tax and accounting law. We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect it.

texts.label: Section 5 (Your choices): paragraph 1
texts.text: You may ask us to access, correct or delete your information, or unsubscribe from the newsletter at any time. See the DPDP Compliance Notice for your rights under Indian law.

texts.text: This notice explains how Sahara Jan Kalyan Samiti handles your personal data under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act).

texts.label: Section 1 (Consent and purpose): paragraph 1
texts.text: We process your personal data only with your consent, given when you submit a form, and only for the purpose stated on that form. You may withdraw consent at any time by writing to us.

texts.label: Section 2: heading
texts.text: Your rights as a Data Principal

texts.label: Section 2 (Your rights as a Data Principal): paragraph 1
texts.text: You have the right to access a summary of your data, ask for correction or erasure, nominate another person to exercise your rights if you are unable to, and have your grievances addressed.

texts.label: Section 3 (Children's data): paragraph 1
texts.text: We do not knowingly collect personal data of children without verifiable consent of a parent or guardian.

texts.label: Section 4 (Grievance officer): paragraph 1
texts.text: Send requests or complaints to info@saharangosag.com with the subject "Data Privacy". We will respond within a reasonable time. If you remain unsatisfied you may approach the Data Protection Board of India.
